children: HIVE Digital Technologies appointed Mark Volk as Senior Vice President, Revenue and reported estimated average daily revenue exceeding $1 million.
BUZZ HPC named Mark Volk SVP, Revenue to lead global go-to-market and scale GPU/AI commercial operations.
Preliminary, unaudited estimates show combined hashrate and GPU cloud services averaged over $1M per day since Aug 21, 2026.
HIVE produced ~12 BTC per day (≈2% of global production) and GPU cloud generated ~ $100,000 daily on average.
Company plans to wind down less productive Swedish mining facilities to repurpose capacity for higher‑value AI/HPC uses.
